Library
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Data import
```{r}
data <- read.csv2("analysis_of_other_data/scRNAseq_data_updated.csv", sep = ",")

rownames(data) = data[,1]

data <- data[,2:ncol(data)]

```

Transpose and add columns(patient, group, cell_id)
```{r}
t_data <- t(data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    patient = sub("_.*", "", rownames(.)),
    group   = ifelse(grepl("_control_", rownames(.)), "Control", "Disease"),
    cell_id = sub(".*_(cell\\d+)$", "\\1", rownames(.))
  ) %>%
  relocate(cell_id, patient, group)

head(rownames(t_data)) 
matrix_t_data <- as.matrix(t_data)
```


```{r}
Group <- factor(t_data$group, levels = c("Control", "Disease")) # Define groups, we usually want HD first
```
